title: 第24章 神兽是小狗？
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
至于孟绯音和孟绯漓在武者大比上的争执，哪里还有人关注。

    人们的注意力早就被这位突然出现，且行事嚣张的大小姐所吸引，纷纷开始打听这位到底是哪里来的人物，有没有机会能巴结上。

    孟绯音望着那道离去的背影，嘴角勾起一抹漫不经心的笑意：原来这个世界，这么有趣吗。

    那她终有一日，会站在这世界之巅，俯视苍生。

    谢家，领着人回到府内的谢闻笙一路忐忑，生怕家中下人伺候不好这尊大神，刚刚他可是跟自己这个大儿子打听了，这位微生小姐平日在太虚宗所食所用，皆是顶级。

    万一她要是对自己准备的东西不满意，会不会一下子不高兴，从而降罪谢家。

    微生璃月不知道谢闻笙脑子里的想法，不过就算知道了也只会感到无语，她在外头虽然是装的嚣张了点，但也不至于这么可怕吧！

    直到将人安顿好，见她没有露出任何不满神色，谢闻笙这才松了口气。

    谢府主院书房，谢长泽抵达时，发现自家父亲满脸愁容，顿时想到是小师妹的原因，安慰道：“父亲不必担心，只要不是有心惹到小师妹，她平时还是挺和善的。”

    至少对他们这几个师兄师姐来说，小师妹不会一个不顺眼就下手。

    对别人的话，那就不知道了，反正他看九王爷今天挺惨的。

    “泽儿，为父明白了。不过你这小师妹，性子是不是有点过于……”谢闻笙还想说些什么，立马被意识到不对的谢长泽打断。

    “父亲，这种话讲不得。”

    小师妹是不在，但要是让父亲养成这种习惯，万一哪天在背地里讨论，又碰巧被那几位听到，他可阻挡不了天一天二他们。

    见儿子神色严肃，谢闻笙顿住了即将出口的话语。

    他懂了，关于这位微生小姐的坏话，在任何时候都说不得。

    此时正在谢家书房屋顶值守把风的天四，刚准备在记仇小本本上写上名字的动作停住，好吧，算这家伙逃过一劫。

    谢长泽和谢闻笙两人走出书房，好巧不巧，正好看到了端坐在屋顶的天四。

    谢闻笙左眼皮立马跳了几下:幸好，幸好啊，刚刚他想说的话被泽儿拦住了，要不然他今天难逃一劫。
content_en:
As for the dispute between Meng Feiyin and Meng Feili in the martial arts competition, no one paid attention to it.

People's attention has long been attracted by this young lady who suddenly appeared and behaved arrogantly. They all began to ask where this person came from and if there was any chance to curry favor with her.

Meng Feiyin looked at the departing figure with a careless smile on her lips: So this world is so interesting.

Then one day she will stand on top of the world and look down on the people.

Xie Wensheng, who led people back to the Xie family, was worried all the way, fearing that the servants in the family would not be able to serve this great god. He just asked his eldest son that the food and drinks that Miss Weisheng eats in Taixu Sect are of the highest quality.

If she is not satisfied with what she has prepared, she will become unhappy all of a sudden and offend the Xie family.

Weisheng Liyue didn't know what was going on in Xie Wensheng's mind, but even if she knew, she would only feel speechless. Although she was pretending to be a bit arrogant outside, she wasn't so scary!

It wasn't until they were settled and she didn't show any dissatisfaction that Xie Wensheng breathed a sigh of relief.

When Xie Changze arrived in the study room of the main courtyard of Xie Mansion, he found that his father had a sad face. He immediately thought that it was the junior sister and comforted him: "Father, don't worry. As long as you don't deliberately offend the junior sister, she is usually quite kind."

At least for these senior brothers and sisters, the junior sister will not attack anyone who doesn't like them.

For others, I don't know. Anyway, he thinks that the Ninth Prince is having a miserable day today.

"Ze'er, father understands. But you, my little junior sister, are a little too temperamental..." Xie Wensheng wanted to say something else, but was immediately interrupted by Xie Changze who realized something was wrong.

"Father, you cannot say such things."

The junior sister is not here, but if his father develops this habit, if he happens to be discussing behind his back one day and is overheard by those few people, he will not be able to stop them every day.

Seeing his son's serious expression, Xie Wensheng paused what he was about to say.

He understood that he could not say anything bad about this Miss Weisheng at any time.

Tiansi, who was on guard duty on the roof of Xie's library at this time, was about to write his name in a small book of vengeance when he stopped. Well, let's assume this guy escaped.

Xie Changze and Xie Wensheng walked out of the study, and by chance, they happened to see Tiansi sitting on the roof.

Xie Wensheng's left eyelid immediately twitched a few times: Fortunately, fortunately, what he wanted to say just now was stopped by Ze'er, otherwise he would not be able to escape today.
title_en: Chapter 24 Is the mythical beast a puppy?
